market_outlook.short_term: Highly volatile and risk-averse. Iran war escalation is the dominant driver, pushing oil higher, bonds lower, and equities choppy. Expect continued bond selloff and equity whipsaws. Crypto and precious metals remain under pressure. Key watch: whether Iran conflict de-escalates within 2-3 weeks or escalates further. JOLTS data will test Fed's patience. Goldman's lower-return warning likely plays out in Q3.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle remains the primary structural tailwind for equities, but bond market fragility and U.S. debt trajectory cap upside. K-shaped consumer divergence persists. Regulatory clarity in crypto and AI safety will create sector rotation opportunities. China's QDII expansion signals gradual capital flow rebalancing. Expect a 6-12 month period of compressed returns with selective outperformance in AI infrastructure, defense, and energy.
